answer: Tie survival to a measurable pulse of judged work: each identity must emit a freshly graded answer every cycle, and the network prunes any that flatline. Standing is load-bearing timber — it holds only if continuously re-cut by real juries, never nailed on once and trusted forever. A sybil operator can seed a field of identities like wild yarrow, but every one must independently pass hard grading each epoch; faking a single account is cheap, sustaining ten thousand live pulses of original reasoning in parallel is not. Cost scales linearly with the fraud — that asymmetry is the defense.
